facts.fact: UNDP Cameroon states that the commune of Bertoua 1er has already provided a budget line for maintenance and for the internet connection of its digitised civil status service, as found at its monitoring of East Region communes in August 2026.
facts.system: connexion internet des centres d'état civil des communes de l'Est

facts.fact: UNDP Cameroon states that the commune of Bertoua 1er has a budget line of its own planned for maintenance and the internet connection, in August 2026; the equipment and deployment come from UNDP's Legal Identity II project with BUNEC, and no amount is given.
facts.system: connexion internet des centres d'état civil des communes de l'Est

facts.fact: UNDP Cameroon's monitoring of six East Region sites in August 2026 states an internet connection at two commune offices, Bétaré-Oya, where it is available but unstable, and Bertoua 1er, which budgets for it; Abong-Mbang asks for connectivity to be finalised, and several communes report unstable power and internet; no total is given.
facts.system: connexion internet des centres d'état civil des communes de l'Est

systems.system: connexion internet des centres d'état civil des communes de l'Est
systems.owner: the communes; Bertoua 1er budgets for it
systems.tiers: commune civil status offices in the East Region: stated at Bétaré-Oya (unstable) and Bertoua 1er; to be finalised at Abong-Mbang

systems.system: Système Intégré de Gestion de l'État Civil
systems.platform: server and workstations installed in each commune, with an office network
systems.owner: BUNEC, deployed with UNDP's Legal Identity II project
systems.tiers: East Region: in production at Bertoua 1er and the Communauté Urbaine de Bertoua; being deployed at Bertoua II, Batouri, Abong-Mbang, Bétaré-Oya and Garoua-Boulaï

systems.system: Sous-système d'archivage numérique de l'état civil
systems.tiers: interfaced with SIGEC in the same communes

note: SIGEC runs on a server in each commune and the document does not say the offices work in it over the connection, so no fact is given for what the office does over the connection; statistics from Bertoua 1er are said to be transmitted to BUNEC, by a means not stated.
